==Acquisition==
Temporarily, as one of the five skills available while under the effect of [[Volfen Blessing]], [[Ursan Blessing]], or [[Raven Blessing]].

==Notes==
*There is an alternate version of this skill available while using the temporary versions of [[Volfen Blessing (Curse of the Nornbear)|Volfen Blessing]] and [[Raven Blessing (A Gate Too Far)|Raven Blessing]], as well as [[Ursan Aura]]. While functionally identical, the alternate version is not listed as being tied to Norn rank.
*This skill starts recharging when it appears on your skillbar after activating [[Raven Blessing]], [[Ursan Blessing]] or [[Volfen Blessing]].
 
{{anomaly|This skill states that you lose all energy when you use it, but in fact you do not lose any energy.}}
